description: Rank and filter your own X posts by real metrics: most liked, most viewed, posts over N likes, a date range, or your latest posts above a threshold (sort 'recent' + min_likes). Includes posts made directly on X, not only via OpenTweet. Metrics refresh from X automatically.

days.description: Restrict to last N days (0 or omit = all time)

limit.description: Number of posts to return (default 10, max 50)

min_impressions.description: Filter out posts below this impression count

min_likes.description: Only posts with at least this many likes

since.description: Only posts on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

until.description: Only posts on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

x_account_id.description: Filter by X account ID (multi-account users)

name: opentweet_get_top_posts
